I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex along with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their family.
Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic manner and inseparable from one another. Community services are the frontline when potential violence against children occurs. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.
In connection with the aforementioned matters, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate this in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex along with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their family.
Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic manner and inseparable from one another. Community services are the frontline when potential violence against children occurs. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.
In connection with the aforementioned matters, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate this in a Regional Regulation.

Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their family.
Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic manner and inseparable from one another. Community services are the frontline when potential violence against children occurs. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.
In connection with the aforementioned matters, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate this in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex along with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their family.
Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic manner and inseparable from one another. Community services are the frontline when potential violence against children occurs. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.
In connection with the aforementioned matters, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate this in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex along with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their family.
Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic manner and inseparable from one another. Community services are the frontline when potential violence against children occurs. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.
In connection with the aforementioned matters, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate this in a Regional Regulation.

I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children are experiencing an increasingly rising trend. Triggering factors such as economic, social, cultural and social environment are becoming more complex along with the influence of technological development. Concrete steps are needed to provide protection by all elements of Citizens as a unity of society, as well as the role of Regional Government as protector for its citizens with various programs to prevent acts of violence against women and children. One of the efforts to prevent violence against women is carried out through women's empowerment and optimization of previously possessed potential, so that it is expected to be able to improve and develop themselves to play a role and be protected from potential acts of violence. This condition will strengthen the form of appreciation and respect for women while maintaining their role and nature as a woman to play a role in educating and supporting the welfare and happiness of their family.
Efforts to prevent violence against children are a shared obligation of parents, families, communities and the private sector in a holistic manner and inseparable from one another. Community services are the frontline when potential violence against children occurs. The mechanism for preventing violence and protecting child victims of violence involves multi-sectors coordinated by the Regional Government. The intended efforts are carried out with the direction of providing social rehabilitation for child victims of violence, reuniting child victims of violence with their families and/or environment, and increasing the empowerment of child victims of violence.
In connection with the aforementioned matters, to realize the provision of protection efforts for women and child victims of violence as well as for legal certainty in the implementation of women's empowerment and protection of child victims of violence in the Regional area, it is necessary to regulate this in a Regional Regulation.

Article 37
The Regional Government may provide assistance to women and children victims of violence. Article 10
(1) Exploitation as referred to in Article 5 letter e, includes:
a. acts of economic or sexual exploitation with the intention of benefiting oneself or others;
b. acts with or without the consent of the victim which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, physical exploitation, sexual exploitation, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting the labor or capabilities of a person by other parties to obtain benefits both material and immaterial; and
c. acts of exploiting children in horse racing activities as jockeys by disregarding the rights of children and/or with the intention of exploiting the labor or capabilities of children to obtain benefits both material and immaterial.
(2) The involvement of children in horse racing activities as jockeys as referred to in paragraph (1) letter c, shall be further regulated in a Regent Regulation.

Article 11
Other violence as referred to in Article 5 (1) letter g, constitutes threat of violence and coercion. Threat of violence as referred to in paragraph (1) @) includes every unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, image, symbol, or body movement, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom.
Coercion as referred to in paragraph (1) includes a @) situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something contrary to their own will.

CHAPTER IV
OBLIGATIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Article 16
The Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Acts of Violence is a joint obligation and responsibility of:
a. Regional Government;
b. Private Sector and Community Institutions;
c. Society; and
d. Family and/or Parents.
